output.title: Renovated 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
Situated in one of Luxembourg's established residential neighborhoods, this penthouse offers 220 m² of refined living space recently renovated to contemporary standards. The bright and airy living area features floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the space with natural light and provide panoramic views of the city skyline. Oak parquet flooring and a wood-burning fireplace contribute to an elegant and comfortable atmosphere. An integrated smart-home lighting system complements the open-plan design, enhancing convenience and ambiance.

The kitchen is fitted with professional-grade Gaggenau appliances and includes a central Carrara marble island ideal for dining and entertaining. Matte black fixtures and a built-in wine fridge underscore the minimalist, high-end aesthetic. The residence includes four bedrooms, with the master suite featuring a walk-in closet, an ensuite bathroom, and direct access to a private terrace.

An expansive terrace extends the living space outdoors, offering 180-degree south-facing views over Luxembourg City. The outdoor lounge area, framed by a glass balustrade and finished with composite decking, creates a setting for relaxation or social gatherings. Additional amenities include elevator access, private parking, and a cellar, enhancing comfort and practicality.

highlights.text: 4 bedrooms including master suite with private terrace
3 bathrooms featuring ensuite in master bedroom
Panoramic 180-degree city views from living room and terrace
Gaggenau-equipped kitchen with Carrara marble island
Terrace with south-facing exposure and outdoor lounge area
Elevator access and private parking space included
